lastText: File ClosedFirst Contact, HeldAllied Pacific Command, Beginning 1940A war that confirmed Europe First at Arcadia, and followed the slower declaration to the edge of its own first contact, then chose not to complete it. A resource area Japan spent a year consolidating unopposed, and a Navy this war's own slower mobilization built without Pearl Harbor's urgency behind it, meet for the first time and immediately step back from each other, real intelligence gathered rather than a decisive engagement risked. What either force actually is, tested against the specific other rather than assumed, is a question this thread closes without answering, honestly, because the real war it diverges from never had cause to ask it either.The Theater Map at the end of the warPacific Situation · The war as it ended · Theater MapJapan: ContestedFormosa: ContestedManchukuo: ContestedNorth China: ContestedEast China: ContestedGuangdong: ContestedHunan-Guangxi: Allied-controlled / liberatedFree China: Allied-controlled / liberatedYan'an: Allied-controlled / liberatedTibet & Xinjiang: Neutral / not yet contestedIndochina: ContestedThailand: ContestedBurma: Allied-controlled / liberatedIndia: Allied-controlled / liberatedMalaya: ContestedSumatra: ContestedJava: ContestedBorneo: ContestedCelebes: ContestedMoluccas & Timor: ContestedLuzon: Allied-controlled / liberatedVisayas: Allied-controlled / liberatedMindanao: Allied-controlled / liberatedNew Guinea: Allied-controlled / liberatedSolomons: Allied-cont
